description: NF22 FRAME_SYNTHETIC identity fixture: frozen synthetic kline-frame schema, three pre-registered row tiers (H22), and the frozen validation rule set. The column contract mirrors the documented DP serial column whitelist (SDK_FRAME_COLUMNS in src/ak_trading/datapipeline/session_factory.py) and the per-tier composition mirrors the documented build_synthetic_frame parameter shape (padding/closed/live/invalid/duplicate rows); the generator code itself is NF22-owned (see tools/benchmarks/workloads/datapipeline.py) because the DP-owner release source-map is PENDING. This fixture is hashed into the case identity: editing it changes the case digest and requires a new expected_digest freeze.

column_contract.mirrors: src/ak_trading/datapipeline/session_factory.py:SDK_FRAME_COLUMNS (documented reference only; not imported by the workload)

validation_rules.check: row datetime must be a finite float (NaN head rows classify as padding, never accepted input rows)
high >= low and high >= max(open, close) and low <= min(open, close)
datetime key must not repeat within a frame (repeats classify as duplicate rows, not newly accepted input rows)

row_generation.step_formula: 1.0 + row_index * 0.5 (mirrors the documented DP synthetic step shape; all values derive deterministically from seed and indices, no RNG)

cycle_policy.tier_cycle: small, medium, large, small, ... (operation k uses tiers[k % 3]; warmup and measured operations advance the same cycle)
cycle_policy.denominator: accepted input rows per operation (units); padding/invalid/duplicate rows are counted and reported but never counted as accepted
